tab1.title: Instructions
tab1.warningInstructions: Using the Face++ service has severe privacy implications. Use at own risk. Read and understand your local privacy legislation, and the terms of use from Face++
tab1.registerInstructions: Each Homey must use a different key. For a free API key, go to console.faceplusplus.com/register
tab1.manageInstructions: After adding the API keys in the settings tab, you can start adding photo's of known persons. These will be used for face recognition. You can add faces by uploading a high quality image (preferred), or by auto-adding from camera snapshots.
tab1.useTitle: How to use in a flow
tab1.useInstructions: Use a flow to send a camera image to the app. The app will try to find faces in this image, and will trigger a flowcard for each face it finds. Note that faces will only be discovered when they are (almost) frontal, and detailed enough (>75 pixels wide). To improve hit-rate try to send 4 snapshots after another, each with 1s extra delay.

tab3.title: Settings
tab3.instructionsKey: Enter the API Key and API Secret that you obtained from the Face++ website. Each Homey must use a different key!
tab3.keyNotSaved: API Key and Secret are not saved!
tab3.keyInvalid: API Key and Secret are not correctly saved!
tab3.instructionsMatch: A higher confidence threshold will reduce incorrect face matches.
tab3.instructionsCrop: Adds a snapshot photo of the detected face to the trigger. Turn off to skip local image processing - detection and matching still work, but the photo will be a placeholder instead.
tab3.cropEnabled: Include a face snapshot in the trigger

tab4.title: Manage Faces
tab4.instructions: Each reference image must contain only one face. Minimum 250x250px, max 2MB file. The label you add will be used in flows on detection.
tab4.label: Label this person
tab4.multipleFacesDetected: Multiple faces detected, but only one is allowed
tab4.invalidToken: Invalid face token. Upload a valid face image.
tab4.deleteFaceWarning: Delete this face? This cannot be undone.
tab4.instructionsAutoAdd: Automatically registers a new face when no match is found and quality is above the threshold. Off by default.

tab5.title: Manage Cloud
tab5.importAlreadyRunning: Import already running, please wait for it to finish.
tab5.fetchFacesStarted: Import started in the background. This can take a while for many faces — check the Log tab, or reopen this tab shortly, to see the result.
tab5.deleteFacesetWarningSuffix: This cannot be undone, and will affect any Homey still using this identifier.
tab5.instructionsThisHomey: Import faces pulls any faces already registered in this Homey's own cloud set into your local list, e.g. after reinstalling the app. Rebuild deletes the cloud stored face templates and replaces them with the current templates in Homey.
tab5.instructionsOtherHomeys: If you use this app on multiple Homeys with the same Face++ API key, each Homey keeps its own private set of known faces by default. Import faces (name only, no photo) from another Homey's set below, or permanently delete a Homey's set — deleting is permanent, and will break stored faces functionality on that Homey.
tab5.importFacesWarning: This will import known faces (name only, no photo) from this Homey's set into the current one. Continue?
tab5.rebuildWarning: This will rebuild this Homey's Face++ cloud faceset from your local Manage Faces list: anything registered in the cloud that isn't in your local list will be removed, then everything in your local list will be re-added. Continue?
tab5.rebuildStarted: Rebuild started in the background. This can take a while for many faces — check the Log tab, or reopen this tab shortly, to see the result.
tab5.rebuildAlreadyRunning: This Homey's cloud faceset is currently being updated, please wait for it to finish.
tab5.importFromCloudWarning: This will import any faces already registered in this Homey's own Face++ cloud set (name only) into your local Manage Faces list. Existing local faces, and any locally stored photos, are left untouched. Continue?
